name: get_trip_status
description: Get the group's full Maui trip plan: dates, party, flights, hotel, transport, activities, running total, and whether it fits the $12,000 budget. Call this first, before anything else.

name: search_flights

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Which month to price: august or october. Omit to use the trip's current month.

description: Search SFO to Maui (OGG) flights for 5 travelers. Returns three priced options, each with a tradeoff to read aloud. Optional month parameter: august or october.

name: book_flight

parameters.name: flight_id
parameters.description: The flight_id from search_flights, for example AA289.

description: Book all 5 travelers onto a chosen flight. Needs the flight_id from search_flights. Only call after the traveler says yes out loud.

name: book_hotel
description: Book the two resort rooms on Maui for the trip's current dates. Only call after the traveler says yes out loud.

name: book_transport
description: Book the minivan with a child car seat at Maui airport (OGG) for the trip's current dates. Only call after the traveler says yes out loud.

name: book_activities

parameters.name: activity
parameters.description: Book one experience only: surf or snorkel. Omit to book both.

description: Book the Maui experiences: a kid-friendly beginner surf lesson and the Molokini snorkeling tour. Omit the activity parameter to book both at once. Only call after the traveler says yes.

name: change_trip_dates

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: The month to move the whole trip to: august or october.

description: Move the whole trip to a different month: august or october. This re-dates and re-prices the flights, hotel, minivan and activities together in one step. Explain what it will do, then only call after a clear yes.

name: confirm_payment

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Amount to charge. Omit to charge the trip's current total.

description: Charge the card on file for the trip total and return a confirmation code. Omit the amount to charge the current total. Only call after the traveler confirms the amount out loud.

name: configure_trip

parameters.name: nights
parameters.description: How many nights on Maui (1-14). Omit to keep the current length.

parameters.name: travelers
parameters.description: Total travelers including kids (1-9). Omit to keep the current party.

parameters.name: rooms
parameters.description: How many hotel rooms (1-6). Omit to keep the current number.

description: Change the trip's size or length and re-price the whole trip. Use this whenever they want anything other than the standard 5 travelers / 7 nights — e.g. fewer nights, more or fewer people, or a different number of rooms. Returns the new dates and total. Never estimate these numbers yourself; call this.
